detail.longDescription: Personal AI assistants have officially stopped being chatbots. Muse, ChatGPT dots, Claude Duet, and Pally now all do some version of the same thing: they run on their own, flag important stuff for you, and take actions autonomously in your connected apps. Zapier extends your AI assistant's reach to apps, and it lets your assistant build automations that run on their own. Here's how it works, and a few ideas to get you started.
